status: Independent scoped acceptance of SEC05 route-label privacy delta; no new blocker found

review.privacy: RequestMetric and recent-error output no longer retain client identity. Middleware only records trusted declared BaseRoute path_format/path or one fixed unmatched label; method uses a finite allowlist. Dynamic path converter inputs, query/body/authorization/cookies/forwarded/client context and private response body are absent from store, summary and alerts in canaries. Identity property/header access trap passes without inspection.
review.integrity: Success, redirect, explicit 500, validation and method-not-allowed responses keep useful declared endpoint labels and correct counts. Unknown metadata and methods collapse. Existing request/error/latency history limits and endpoint alert signal are retained in the 111-request canary.
review.callers: Repository search found RequestMetric construction and record(metric) only inside MetricsMiddleware; removing the exported client_ip field does not leave a repository caller mismatch.
review.product_delta: Only web/middleware/metrics.py changed; author tests/docs reviewed. No product edit, commit, integration, CI mutation, provider I/O, real request data or HTTP listener in this review.

limits: Exceptions raised before call_next returns are not recorded; an explicit independent test proves this pre-existing boundary. No complete 500 coverage claim.
Factory API mounts MetricsMiddleware; SaaS factory does not gain metrics from this change. Existing factory/auth/tenant tests replayed, while new canaries use isolated synthetic ASGI apps.
Route metadata is trusted application configuration; no general defense is claimed against malicious application route registration or direct untrusted construction of internal metrics objects.

Prefix exclusions are unchanged; no endpoint coverage expansion, durable metrics, distributed alerts, real delivery, retention policy, rate-limiter IP change or legal-compliance claim. R17/R31 broader scopes remain open.
Loopback is permitted for Windows asyncio socketpair; all external connect/connect_ex are blocked and provider configuration cleared before imports.

harness_errata.result: 15 setup/runtime failures before assertions could assess product: Windows asyncio creates a loopback self-pipe via socketpair/connect. Raw logs/XML/JSON preserved separately. Replaced only harness network guard with repository external-destination blocker.

harness_errata.result: 3 lifecycle fixture failures plus 12 passes. Added correct lifespan startup/shutdown handling only; no assertions or product changed. Raw partial results preserved; final current and Git baseline then used identical 15 criteria.
